_comment: Per Plan v5 D3, classify divergences as expected (intentional NES↔Gen design difference) vs bug.

SCENE.fc: FrameCounter — NES and Gen tick at different rates due to NMI vs VBlank timing
SCENE.rng: RNG advances per NES NMI; Gen advances per SGDK frame tick — divergence expected
SCENE.invclk: InvClock derived from FrameCounter — same root timing diff
SCENE.bomb_count: Gen Debug.md loads with debug inventory; NES fresh save = empty
SCENE.song_request: Gen audio driver differs from NES APU

LINK.anim: Link animation frame tracks FrameCounter; timing-dependent
LINK.hp_cur: Gen Debug.md preloads inventory; NES fresh save
LINK.inv_timer: Gen post-warp invincibility from apply_warp_outcome ramp
LINK.state: Mode 5 init differs between NES @InitMode5Play and Gen RoomRom scene_load
LINK.x: Gen apply_warp_outcome sets dest_link_x; NES Mode 5 picks from level data

SLOTS.mvTm: Move timer counts down per NES OAM tick — timing dependent
SLOTS.wTSh: WhetherToShoot rolls each frame from RNG

RAM_FULL._note: Many RAM cells timing-dependent. Treat RAM_FULL as opaque after enemy slots covered

expected.CPU_REGS_NES: Register state at probe-end frame is non-deterministic between cores
expected.VRAM_TILE_SCENE_OBJ: Gen-only — no NES equivalent in dump
expected.BG_A_PLANE: Gen-only — Gen plane vs NES nametable architectural diff
expected.CHR_WINDOW: NES-only — Gen tiles dumped in VRAM_TILE_SCENE_OBJ instead
expected.CRAM_RAW: Gen raw palette — covered by reverse-translated PALRAM diff

real_bugs_focus.PALRAM: Palette mismatches — fixable via per-room palette table
real_bugs_focus.OAM: Sprite render — Y/tile/attr should match NES at frame 120
